WITH matched_data AS (
  SELECT 
    s.scancount,
    s.gbsize,
    s.spanmin,
    z.healtheval
  FROM scans s
  INNER JOIN sites z ON s.zoneref = z.zoneregistry
),
group_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    healtheval,
    SUM(scancount) as sum_scans,
    AVG(CASE WHEN gbsize IS NOT NULL AND spanmin IS NOT NULL AND spanmin != 0 
             THEN gbsize / spanmin 
             ELSE NULL END) as per_group_avg
  FROM matched_data
  GROUP BY healtheval
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(per_group_avg) as overall_avg
  FROM group_stats
  WHERE per_group_avg IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  gs.healtheval,
  gs.sum_scans,
  gs.per_group_avg,
  gs.per_group_avg - oa.overall_avg as difference
FROM group_stats gs
CROSS JOIN overall_average oa
WHERE gs.per_group_avg IS NOT NULL
  AND oa.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
  AND gs.per_group_avg > oa.overall_avg
